title: Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) Program
funder: Creative Destruction Lab (nonprofit, founded at the University of Toronto's Rotman School of Management)
deadline_note: Applications for the 2026/27 program closed July 24, 2026 at 11:59PM ET. No dates for the 2027/28 cycle are published as of 2026-11-24.
amount: No funding from CDL itself; no fees and no equity taken. Mentorship program; mentors who are investors 'often invest', but 'there is no guaranteed investment'

summary.at_a_glance: CDL is a nonprofit, objectives-based mentorship program for seed-stage science- and technology-based companies, run at 17 locations in 10 countries across about 26 streams. It charges no fees and takes no equity. The 2026/27 intake is closed; the next cycle has not been announced.
summary.what_they_offer: Focused mentorship from accomplished entrepreneurs and investors, technical guidance from leading scientists and engineers, personalized 8-week objectives, and access to CDL's global network of founders, funders and researchers. Accepted startups attend up to five full-day sessions between October and June. CDL does not fund ventures directly.
summary.what_theyre_looking_for: From the official FAQ: 'ventures with technology that is novel, defensible and scalable with exciting potential, and a team that seems well positioned to drive the success of that technology.' CDL typically admits companies 'that have advanced beyond the concept stage and that have developed or are working on a prototype'; the sweet spot is ventures planning to raise a seed round (approx. US $500K to $5M) within 12 months of applying. Pre-revenue is fine. Official application tips: be concise and avoid jargon, show momentum, describe founders' demonstrated excellence in any domain, explain why you are passionate about the problem, be honest about challenges, and try to get a reference from a past participant or mentor.
summary.who_can_apply: Companies from anywhere in the world can apply to any CDL location; no university affiliation required, no relocation required (a founder must attend each session, with at least one in person at the host site). Solo founders are allowed, though most admitted ventures have two or more co-founders. Participation in another accelerator at the same time is allowed. Streams relevant to a US health/AI startup: Computational Health (CDL-Seattle), Health & Wellness (CDL-Wisconsin), Healthcare Delivery (CDL-Cleveland), Health (CDL-Berlin, CDL-Doha), Artificial Intelligence (Doha, Montreal, Paris, San Sebastian, Toronto), and Prime (general).
summary.how_to_apply: 1) When applications are open, fill in the short form on the Apply page to create a CDL Application Portal account. 2) Receive an email invitation to the CDL Application Portal. 3) Log in to the portal. 4) Complete and submit the CDL Program Application (up to 5 sites/streams can be selected and ranked). 5) Shortlisted ventures are told by mid-August and interviewed mid- to late August (online option if more than a 1-2 hour drive from the site). 6) Admission decisions in early September by a selection committee at each location, with a matching process. 7) Program sessions run October to June.
summary.worth_noting: The Apply page says 'Applications are currently closed', yet the account-creation form is still shown on it, and a stale banner on other CDL pages still says 'Applications are now open for the 2026/27 program year'. The last cycle's deadline was July 24, 2026 (a 2021 CDL announcement shows that cycle opened in mid-April), so the next intake is likely in 2027, but CDL has not published dates. Contact: admissions@creativedestructionlab.com. Stream contacts: cdl-seattle@, cdl-wisconsin@, cdl-cleveland@, health@creativedestructionlab.com.

portal.platform: Custom: public web form on creativedestructionlab.com (Salesforce/Pardot form handler at venture.creativedestructionlab.com), then the invitation-only 'CDL Application Portal'
portal.notes: Two steps. Step 1 is a public form (no login, no CAPTCHA seen) that requests a portal account; do not submit it while applications are closed. It contains an off-screen honeypot field labelled 'Comments' (name pardot_extra_field) that must be left empty. Website must start with http:// or https://. The State field only appears when Country is United States or Canada. Step 2, the real application, is inside the CDL Application Portal, reached through an emailed invitation and a login; its address is not published. The site's 'Log in to Community' link (community.creativedestructionlab.com) is a Salesforce login page; whether it is the same portal was not confirmed.

questions_note: PARTIAL. Only Step 1 is listed: the public form on the Apply page that creates a CDL Application Portal account, read from the live page on 2026-11-24 (nothing typed or submitted). The actual CDL Program Application questions are NOT included and could not be seen: they sit inside the CDL Application Portal, which needs an emailed invitation and a login, applications are closed, and CDL publishes no preview or question list (FAQ, program pages and CDL blog posts were checked). Required flags follow the asterisks on the labels; 'Website' and 'Stream(s) of Interest' carry an asterisk but are not enforced by the browser. 'State / Province' is shown only when Country is United States (relabelled 'State*', options listed here) or Canada (relabelled 'Province / Territory*', with 13 provinces and territories instead). The Country list is copied as shown, including the entries 'TBD' and 'Korea'. This form belongs to the closed 2026/27 cycle and may change when the next cycle opens.
